caveats: ⚑ EFFECT-KIND AVAILABILITY: the schema excerpt supplied to this blind pass lists no `heal` member in EffectDef, yet the `recovery` TriggerDef comment references "a 'heal' effect targets them". Both heal lines are authored as {kind:'heal', maxHpPct} by analogy to the `shield` effect (maxHpPct = % of CASTER final Max HP). If validate-overrides rejects that kind, the two heal lines move verbatim to `unmodeled` and this unit becomes fully effect-free offensively — do NOT silently re-encode them as a stat buff.

⚑ SKILL1 TRIGGER SHAPE: `chargeCounter` with a scalar count of 3 and a single effect is the closest schema match to "landing 3 Full Charge attack(s)"; the assumption is that the phase counter wraps and re-fires every 3rd full charge for the whole fight. If the engine's chargeCounter only walks the effects[] array once, the block fires once and under-credits.

⚑ SKILL1 PROC CADENCE: the proc rate is entirely a function of the datamined charge cadence (chargeFrames 60, ammo 6, reloadFrames 141) — a known-unreliable datamine surface. Every heal count downstream of skill1 inherits that uncertainty.

TANDEM (not a flag, a warning): both heal lines and the shield line are offensively inert in isolation but ARE the input to teammates' `recovery` and `shielded` triggers (e.g. a crown-style "when recovery takes effect" damage buff). They must never be dropped as "defensive".
"landing" in skill1 implies the full-charge attack must connect; the model treats every full charge as landing (no miss channel exists at scope lock).
"Affects 2 ally unit(s) with the highest final ATK" is authored byFinalAtk:true per the literal-word rule ("final ATK"), so ranking reads live effectiveAtk, not staticAtk.
override.note: PARSER BASELINE (HYPOTHESIS — NOT a validated model). Every ⚑ below is an UNMEASURED estimate; hand-tune + record against a real fight before trusting any number. Claire is a pure sustain Supporter (RL/Electric/Burst I): S1 heals the 2 highest-final-ATK allies for 2.86% of her own final Max HP every 3rd landed full charge; S2 shields all allies for 10.13% of her final Max HP for 10s on her own burst cast; her burst heals all allies for 34.35% of her final Max HP and cleanses 1 debuff. No damage line, no stat buff, no weapon-state modifier, no gauge line anywhere in the kit — her entire contribution to a damage sim is (a) her own base RL fire and (b) driving teammates' recovery/shielded triggers. The cleanse is unmodeled: there is no debuff-removal primitive and the scope-lock boss applies no debuffs, so it is scope-inert. Both heals are authored with the `heal` effect kind by analogy to `shield`; see caveats — the supplied schema excerpt did not list that member.

audit.effectOrReason: trigger {kind:'chargeCounter', count:3} — per-full-charge phase counter, the schema's only full-charge-counting trigger. Not hitCount (that counts rounds/normal hits, not full charges); not interval (the kit states an explicit activation condition).

audit.kitLine: Affects 2 ally unit(s) w/ highest ATK
audit.effectOrReason: target {kind:'alliesTopAtk', count:2, byFinalAtk:true} — "final ATK" is literal, so live-effectiveAtk ranking. No excludeSelf (kit does not say "except the skill user").

{kind:'heal', maxHpPct:2.86} — % of the SKILL USER's final Max HP (caster-scaled, same convention as the shield effect). Heal lines are never skipped on isolation (HARD RULE: tandem/cross-unit — this fires teammates' `recovery` triggers). "Green Herb" is a flavor label, not a stack/currency.
trigger {kind:'burstCast'} — literal "when using Burst Skill" = this unit's OWN burst cast, NOT fullBurstEnter. Keying it to fullBurstEnter would over-credit on rotations where Claire does not burst.
target {kind:'allies'} — no excludeSelf clause, so the caster is included.

{kind:'shield', maxHpPct:10.13, durationSec:10} — maxHpPct is % of CASTER final Max HP per the schema. Recorded for kit completeness AND because it fires teammates' `shielded` triggers; no HP pool is modeled at scope lock.
target {kind:'allies'}, trigger {kind:'burstCast'} — a burst block with no separate activation clause fires on the owner's burst cast.

audit.kitLine: Restores 34.35% ... final Max HP as HP
audit.effectOrReason: {kind:'heal', maxHpPct:34.35} — caster-Max-HP-scaled team heal; same tandem rationale as S1.
No debuff-removal primitive exists in EffectDef, and the scope-lock boss applies no debuffs to allies, so the line is scope-inert. Recorded verbatim in unmodeled.burst.

Whole-picture check: the kit contains zero ATK/crit/damage-taken/ammo/reload/fire-rate/charge-speed/burst-gauge lines and no weapon swap. Nothing was dropped — there is genuinely no offensive line to model. Consequently `noFb` is not set anywhere (no function-damage rider exists), and `noRange` is engine-automatic.

flags.estimate: {kind:'chargeCounter', count:3} — recurring every 3rd landed full charge for the whole fight
flags.reasoning: The schema documents chargeCounter as a CYCLING phase counter whose phase P fires effects[P]. With one effect and a scalar count, the intended reading is "fire every 3 full charges", but the wrap behaviour after the single phase is not stated in the excerpt. If the counter walks effects[] exactly once and stops, this block fires once at ~3 charges instead of ~every 3 charges — a large under-credit on a 180s fight.
flags.recipe: In a vitest harness fixture (controlComp with claire, cfg.onEvent), count buffApply/heal-side events attributable to claire's skill1 over a full 180s run and divide by her observed full-charge count; expect ≈ n_fullCharges/3. If the count is exactly 1, re-key to {kind:'hitCount', count:3} (RL hitsPerShot 1, so rounds ≈ charges) and re-check.
